generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The payment made on availability of muncipal fund

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years that is 2021-22 to 2025-26, achieved in at least a financial years minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 8.2 lakhs, Turnover Certified should be issued by the charted accountant with profit loss statement with UDIN
The bidder should submit Valid Class-III and above Electrical Contractor Registration Certificate.
SC Reserved Category Certificate along with valid domipile certification

Satisfactorily completed in last five years at least one similar nature of single Work of for the value not less than Rs.2.05 Lakhs as a prime contractor. The work done certificate must be certified by Executive Engineer and above rank only
